sql: select e.key exp, 'v'||v.version||'/e'||ep.epoch_number ve, to_char(ep.started_at,'MM-DD') ep_start, to_char(ep.ended_at,'MM-DD') ep_end, d.deployment_key dep, d.kind, to_char(d.started_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') dstart, to_char(d.ended_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') dend, a.arm_key, da.strategy_tag tag from experiments e join experiment_versions v on v.experiment_id=e.id join experiment_epochs ep on ep.version_id=v.id join experiment_deployments d on d.epoch_id=ep.id join experiment_deployment_arms da on da.deployment_id=d.id join experiment_arms a on a.id=da.arm_id where e.key in ('mmsell-price-ceiling','mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity','mmsell-price-ceiling-contest-cap','mmsell-price-ceiling-size-split','mmsell-price-ceiling-cell-size') order by e.key, v.version, ep.epoch_number, d.started_at
